clauses: Fees are billed on a time-and-materials basis at the hourly rates in Exhibit A, which are fixed for the SOW term.
Total fees and expenses under this SOW shall not exceed $96,000.00 (NTE) without a signed change order.
Consultant invoices monthly in arrears, with a timesheet summary by role and resource.
Reimbursable expenses are billed at actual cost with no markup, administrative or handling fee. Receipts are required for any item of $25.00 or more.
Air travel: economy class only. Lodging: up to $275.00 per night. Meals: per diem up to $75.00 per day.
Reimbursable expenses in any invoice may not exceed 10% of the fees billed on that invoice without prior written approval from the Controller.
Professional services are not subject to sales tax.
Invoices are payable Net 30 from the invoice date.
